from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityMetric(BaseModel):
    """One university's enrollment and graduation metrics from a CDS report."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    freshmen_count: int | None = Field(description="Number of degree-seeking, first-time, first-year freshmen")
    graduation_rate_2015_cohort: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate as a percentage (0-100)")
    graduation_rate_period: str | None = Field(description="The cohort period, e.g., 'Fall 2015'")
    source_section: str | None = Field(description="CDS section where the data comes from, e.g., 'B1', 'C1', 'B4'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_metrics: list[UniversityMetric]
